notes: The half build needs upright or squarish photographs of at least 720×900; a client with only wide pictures gets bands (clinic1), a client with fewer than four large pictures gets fewer picture screens (law1).
More than about 12 people without portraits make the people section very long.
A trailing ellipsis is taken off button labels (clinic1's "Termin buchen …" is the client's own string; it read as cut).
drops (as written): brand.logo (the name is set in type, as the reference's is)
drops (as written): media.screens, media.phones, media.video, media.made
drops (as written): steps.items[].img (pictures are placed by role, not tied to a step) and steps.items[].title when it has a k
drops (as written): credentials[].img and credentials[].year (badges are not shown; title and text are)
drops (as written): quotes beyond the third; quotes[].title
drops (as written): photographs beyond the four bands and the portraits; any photograph under 1100 px wide or upright; role product
drops (as written): nav items that do not fit the half-width bar on a wide screen (all of them are in the phone menu)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (no made pictures are read)
